what: The box background fills from the bottom edge upward, height 0 → 100% (.6s cubic-bezier(.86,0,.27,.98) — very slow at start and end, a burst through the middle), and the text color flips to the inverse of the background over .6s ease-in-out. On release it drains downward along the same path. The box for the current area / current section (aria-current) stays filled — top box menu, fixed action button

options.--fx-fill · --fx-on: Rising fill and the text color above it, default --kf-ink · --kf-bg (for an ink fill on a purple button, set --fx-on to the original text color)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease · --fx-color-dur: Fill-up duration, curve and text-color duration, default .6s · cubic-bezier(.86,0,.27,.98) · .6s
options.look: top: Fills in from the top edge downward
options.aria-current: Always filled while attached (current section menu cell)
options.look: left: Width fills from the left edge to the right
options.leave: snap: On release it empties immediately with no transition and the text color returns at once (transition only on enter)
options.--fx-leave-ease: Curve when the hand is released (both fill and text color), same as the default entering

note: Use CSS only (lay ::after behind — set isolation: isolate on the element)

from.where: shared.css .mc-toplink·.mc-cta__btn — original .top-link::after·.action-button::after: height 0 → 100% .6s cubic-bezier(.86,0,.27,.98), .top-link color .6s ease-in-out, the current section cell (w--current) is filled

index.html .mk-fill (original .txt-box:before · .border-text:before · .menu-item-link::before — fluorescent yellow width 0→100% .5s (buttons and menu .3s) cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1), the menu fills only for the current section (now_area), and in location rows the title and name cells fill together when the pointer is over the whole link)
